title: Anthropic loses product lead Catherine Wu behind Claude Code to OpenAI
summary: Anthropic product lead Catherine Wu departs Claude Code team to join OpenAI
detailed: OpenAI hired Catherine Wu, who led product for Claude Code at Anthropic, to run product management for 'Core Products'.
Growth marketing manager Austin Lau also moved from Anthropic to OpenAI, alongside recent departures of engineers Thariq Shihipar and Anthony Morris.
Wu stated her goal is to build AI agents that take work off users' plates while keeping them in control.
This matters because it highlights the intense talent and product strategy competition between OpenAI and Anthropic at the model and developer-tool levels.
sentences: OpenAI poaches a Claude Code co-developer from Anthropic.

Catherine Wu, who led product for Claude Code at Anthropic, is joining OpenAI to run product management for "Core Products," a hire that underscores the fierce competition between the two companies, which plays out not just at the model level but across pricing, product strategy, and talent.

Codex and ChatGPT head Thibault Sottiaux welcomed her with a one-word quip: "CatGPT."
Wu says she wants to build agents that take work off users' plates while keeping them in control.
By her own account , she joined Anthropic two years ago, when Claude Code was still a small internal tool and most users approved every permission request by hand.
Today, the default is to trust Claude's judgment, and Claude handles large migrations and builds new products, Wu says.
Growth marketing manager Austin Lau is also moving from Anthropic to OpenAI.
Beyond those two, Anthropic has recently lost skills and context engineer Thariq Shihipar and Anthony Morris , who built Claude Code Desktop, though neither has gone to OpenAI, at least not yet.
